title: TikTok pack 1 (21 originals, Shorts v3, Andrew)
_note: TikTok pack 1, Shorts v3 (research/44; Showrunner + Studio, 2026-10-24). 21 original animal videos for TikTok only: 14 at 20-25 s and 7 single-animal deep dives at 61-75 s (longer jeopardy stories with more escalation, for Creator Rewards). Meatball tries something, it goes wrong, the true fact is the punchline. Lines are 8 words or fewer, with an action and SFX on every line and a joke or reveal every few seconds. The animal is named in the first 2 words, and frame 0 shows the photo and the claim. One Fork + tink per video. 11 of 21 end on a spoken 'Comment.' ask before the loop line, never in the first 3 s. Voice: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural at +0% then atempo 1.10, as the v3 prototype (free; Nolan 10/24: one Meatball voice on short-form). Hooks from research/43. Photos: iNaturalist research-grade CC0/CC BY, captive=false, looked at one by one (live wild animals of the right species; no injuries or dead animals). Facts web-checked 10/24; sources on each hook beat; uncertain numbers softened. '_len' marks short/deep.

beats.say: Ironclad beetles survive being run over.

sources: Rivera et al. 2020, Nature (Purdue/UC Irvine): exoskeleton withstands ~149 N, about 39,000x body weight; the team ran one over with a Toyota Camry and it survived — https://edition.cnn.com/2020/10/21/world/beetle-engineering-intl-scli-scn
Interlocking elytra 'jigsaw' suture — https://www.ecowatch.com/diabolical-ironclad-beetle-science-2648439624.html
Diet: fungi under the bark of dead trees (ironclad beetles, Zopheridae).

sources: Science News / Discover on Sugiura & Sato 2018: spray reaches about 100 °C; one vomited beetle lived 562 more days — https://www.discovermagazine.com/bombardier-beetles-refuse-to-be-toad-snacks-37445

Sugiura & Sato 2018, Biology Letters: Pheropsophus jessoensis fed to Japanese toads; 43% of toads vomited the beetles 12-107 min later; all vomited beetles alive and active; larger beetles escaped more often; smaller toads vomited more often — https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.ng788
Smithsonian, 'How Exploding Beetles Can Survive Being Eaten Alive' — https://www.smithsonianmag.com/smart-news/how-exploding-beetles-cause-japanese-toads-vomit-180968095/
Mechanism: hydroquinones + hydrogen peroxide mixed with enzymes in a reaction chamber; the spray comes in rapid pulses and can be aimed (Eisner; Dean et al. 1990).
